_note: Reviewed, deterministic, NUMBER-FREE exclusion-note texts. A curated note replaces only the note TEXT of its flag; the note keeps its flag_ref and the flag's verified source quotation. The audited flag row stays unchanged in the flags CSV; its SHA-256 below must still match, or the derivation refuses (the audited reason changed and the curated text must be re-reviewed).

F042.note: Table IX reports a burning-rate constant for FLEX-010, but Figure 14 states that no burning-rate constant is reported. The disputed measurement is excluded from quantitative use pending reconciliation with PSI data.
